title: Krull dimension of a topological space at a point
statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space and $x\in X$. The *Krull dimension of $X$ at $x$* is

$$
\dim_x X=\min\{\dim U: x\in U\subseteq X\text{ open}\},
$$

the minimum, over the open neighbourhoods [def-kun-open-neighbourhood] $U$ of $x$ in $X$, of the Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of $U$ with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology] (an element of $\{0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$, since every such $U$ contains $x$ and so is nonempty; the minimum exists because every nonempty family in $\{-\infty,0,1,\ldots,\infty\}$ has a least element [lem-kun-extended-naturals-minimum]).
